items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Interview with Paul L. Howard by Patricia Willard and Buddy Collette

ctx.x: Were you doing any singing at that point at Virginia's?
Yeah, I did a lot of singing. Oh I aint going to tell you all them things. Ms. Willard: Why not?
You did, huh? You want to keep secrets from us. See, we know about some of these things.
